scenario: An obstetric agent pipeline reviews a third-trimester prenatal lab panel, a home blood-pressure log, and a urine-protein result for signs of preeclampsia. The pipeline normalizes and validates the raw lab values and vital-sign entries, evaluates the standardized values for clinical urgency against preeclampsia criteria, and produces an OB triage memo recommending next steps for the patient and care team.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner normalizes the raw prenatal lab panel, blood-pressure log, and urine-protein value into a standardized structured summary → medical-triage classifies the urgency level of the case based on the normalized clinical indicators → health-report composes the OB triage memo with a follow-up recommendation derived from the triage classification.
